claim: Perspective construction is an explicit background-art decision in anime, made by a person at a drawing board rather than fallen out of a lens. Flat and isometric read as designed and unreal; three_point looms and makes architecture threatening.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: flat perspective, no vanishing point, orthographic
three-point perspective, vertical vanishing point, dramatic perspective
isometric view, isometric perspective, parallel projection
fisheye perspective, curved wide angle view
overhead plan view, top-down map view, from directly above

review.issue: fisheye is the third card carrying a fisheye option — lens.look.fisheye ("fisheye lens, fisheye, barrel distortion"), lens.distortion.fisheye ("fisheye, fisheye lens, circular distortion"), and this one — with effectively the same tags, so three cards would ship the same panel. overhead_map ("overhead plan view, top-down map view, from directly above") is the same instruction as cam.angle.top_down and cam.height.overhead. flat's "no vanishing point" is a negation. two_point vs one_point is a distinction Animagine draws only by accident.
review.fix: Give fisheye a single owner (lens.distortion is the natural one) and remove it from the other two cards; likewise give the straight-down view a single owner (cam.angle). Reduce this card to flat / one_point / three_point / isometric — the four the model actually differentiates — and rewrite flat affirmatively as "orthographic, flat composition".
